motion.kind: Actual rendered app screenshots from synthetic fixture, encoded as a video; no artwork edits. Browser clock stepped at manifest durations.
motion.encoding: H264, 50fps with duplicated still frames; video is for visual review, not an app asset.

reproduction: capture.mjs reproduces the three-width fixtures, geometry, controls, task paths and lifecycle/error checks. The motion clip was captured separately by stepping the browser clock at the recorded frame durations. Independent A edge cases are in evidence/a-edge-verification.json.
unexercised: Real mobile device battery/CPU use and live-service usability.
Real browser background-tab lifecycle on mobile; hidden state was simulated, offscreen scrolling was real.
Production saved-shell/service-worker integration and offline updates; no app integration was performed.
